confidence_note: The death is measured: on 2026-10-30 DNS-over-HTTPS queries for the A record of pcdeploy.net answered NXDOMAIN at two public resolvers (Cloudflare and Google), with the .net zone SOA as the authority, and the .net registry's RDAP service answered HTTP 404 for the domain.
